names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 5 aprilie, «Sfânta Cuvioasă Teodora din Tesalonic».

Read out of the title on the name link behind her line for 5 апреля ст. ст., name page 2711, «Феодора Солунская (Фессалоникийская), прп.», with the rank abbreviation left off and the city kept in both the forms the calendar prints. The day’s own line gives «Феодоры Солунской» in the genitive. No folder holds this form, and none holds «Феодора Солунская» alone.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 5 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Феодоры Солунской (892).»

attestations.note: Read off doxologia.ro's day list for 3 august (24 September 2026), but her own page on that site heads her feast 5 Aprilie, and the feast recorded here is the one her own page gives. The two days are both doxologia's; only 5 aprilie is recorded, because one attestation row per church is the schema. The identification is with this folder and not a new one: the Romanian life is the life this folder already carries — born on the island of Aegina of the Orthodox parents Antonie and Hrisanta under Michael the Stammerer, married and mother of a daughter, moved to Thessalonica in a barbarian invasion, tonsured in her daughter's convent after her husband's death, and the miracle at the opening of the abbess's grave, where after many years Theodora moved to make room for her. 5 aprilie was not itself read (24 September 2026).

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 29 Αυγούστου — «Οσία Θεοδώρα η εν Θεσσαλονίκη»
Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 11.09.2026 (29. август ст. ст.) — „Преп. Теодора Солунска.“

death.note: Two books disagree by thirteen years and the range is widened to hold both rather than choose. The folder held a flat 879, basis attested, off the Ohrid Prologue: reposed in her seventy-fifth year, in 879. days.pravoslavie.ru closes her line for 5 апреля ст. ст. with «(892)» and its life marks the death «(+ 892)» in the body. Neither book gives a day of the month for the death and neither cites the other; nothing is averaged and the basis drops to traditional because the two attestations cannot both be right.
